notes.title: "sushininjarobot TD" is Available NOW
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support! My game is now available on Steam.
I hope you'll check it out!

notes.title: Release Date: 2025.9.24
notes.notes:
The release date for "sushininjarobot TD" has been set for September 24, 2025.
Thank you for your wishlist. Please wait a little longer for the release.

The following updates have been made in preparation for the release:

[list]
[*] Demo version 0.9.0 released with many optimizations and a longer opening
[*] The trailer has been updated to include more detailed gameplay information
[*] Screenshots updated to the latest version
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.3.0: Four new card types have been added
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to v0.3.0 with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added "Hearts" "Diamonds" "Spades" "Clubs" type cards
[*] Added a new weapon "Hat" and its upgrade "Hat Missile"
[*] Added a new tower "Elevator Sauce" and its upgrade "Flying Sauce"
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.2.0: Improved Display & Added Tutorials
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to v0.2.0 with the following changes:

[list]
[*] The font on the cards has been made larger
[*] Added tutorial display as player's progress
[*] Added display of attack power and rate of fire for weapons and towers
[*] Added a new weapon "Hamster Wheel" and its upgrade "Sunflower Seeds"
[/list]

notes.title: Mini-Update v0.1.1: Bug Fixes and Processing Optimizations
notes.notes:
The number of sushininjarobot TD wishlists has exceeded 100! Thank you everyone!

The demo has been updated to v0.1.1 with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Some translation corrections
[*] Fixed wrong critical animation position
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain cards to have infinite attack speed
[*] Fixed incorrect collision for "dog"
[*] To reduce the load, the number of individuals that can be produced from "queenslime" and "bigface" are limited to a maximum of 20
[*] Added optimization for off-screen objects
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.1.0: More Power-Ups/Cards for All Weapons & Towers
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to v0.1.0 with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added one more appearing powerup/card to every weapon/tower
[*] Implemented highlight function in card list
[*] Added "Ghost" type cards: they are used once and gone... basically
[*] Added a new weapon "Tonfa" and its upgrade "Tonfa Beam"
[*] Added a new weapon "Bamboo Copter" and its upgrade "Paper Baloon"
[*] Added a new tower "Eyes" and its upgrade "Kiss"
[*] Added a new tower "Domino" and its upgrade "Pivot"
[*] Added a feedback form link to the demo version.
[/list]

notes.title: Mini Update v0.0.6: Translation fixes
notes.notes:
v0.0.6 has been released with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Add some cards
[*] Card unveiling conditions are now displayed on the card in < >
[*] Some translation corrections
[/list]

notes.title: The demo version is available for play!
notes.notes:
sushininjarobot TD 0.0.5 has been released.
This version is the first version of sushininjarobot TD that can be played as a demo version.
I am aiming for a release in 2025, and I plan to continue polishing it for the final version.

In particular, there may still be many changes to be made to the balance of cards.
